message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charge(s) for the case: 黄1某, a full-time staff (state employee) responsible for school cafeteria funds management. He used forged transfer checks, stole cafeteria seal and principal's seal, transferred 480,000 RMB from cafeteria account to his mother's account, then repeated transfers or cash withdrawals, returning part of the money. Total embezzlement 2,829,550.2? Actually 282.95502万 = 2,829,550.2 RMB. Of which 1,760,574.67 still not returned. He is a state employee, used position to misappropriate public funds, over 3 months not returned, serious. This is classic "挪用公款". The list includes "挪用公款". Also possibly "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" because he stole the cafeteria seal and principal's seal, but the primary charge is "挪用公款". In examples, similar case: first example about "挪用公款" (the first Q). So answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>. No other charges.
